Class FT_GlyphSlot

java.lang.Object
org.lwjgl.system.Pointer.Default
org.lwjgl.system.Struct<FT_GlyphSlot>
org.lwjgl.util.freetype.FT_GlyphSlot
All Implemented Interfaces:
Pointer
@NativeType("struct FT_GlyphSlotRec") public class FT_GlyphSlot extends Struct<FT_GlyphSlot>
struct FT_GlyphSlotRec {
    FT_Library library;
    FT_Face face;
    FT_GlyphSlot next;
    FT_UInt glyph_index;
    FT_Generic generic;
    FT_Glyph_Metrics metrics;
    FT_Fixed linearHoriAdvance;
    FT_Fixed linearVertAdvance;
    FT_Vector advance;
    FT_Glyph_Format format;
    FT_Bitmap bitmap;
    FT_Int bitmap_left;
    FT_Int bitmap_top;
    FT_Outline outline;
    FT_UInt num_subglyphs;
    FT_SubGlyph subglyphs;
    void * control_data;
    long control_len;
    FT_Pos lsb_delta;
    FT_Pos rsb_delta;
    void * other;
    FT_Slot_Internal internal;
}

  • Constructor Details

    • FT_GlyphSlot

      public FT_GlyphSlot(ByteBuffer container)
      Creates a FT_GlyphSlot instance at the current position of the specified ByteBuffer container. Changes to the buffer's content will be visible to the struct instance and vice versa.

      The created instance holds a strong reference to the container object.
